'''2001 FreedomCon afternoon tournament (17 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held at Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia on 17 November 2001. It is known from John Veasey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3124">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-27-veez-at-freedomcon-11-15-17-2001d3124/ veez-at-freedomcon-11-15-17-2001], DeckTech (John "jpvz" Veasey, 27 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-27-veez-at-freedomcon-11-15-17-2001d3124/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 17 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Sheraton Oceanfront Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Gemme]]<ref name="tr-d3139" />
